title: Asthma Attack
immediate_warning: If the person cannot speak, lips are blue, or reliever inhaler is not helping after 10 minutes — call 112.

description: An asthma attack causes the airways to narrow, making breathing very difficult. Most attacks can be managed with the correct inhaler.

description_translations.en: An asthma attack causes the airways to narrow, making breathing very difficult. Most attacks can be managed with the correct inhaler.

steps.instruction: Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.

instruction_translations.en: Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person calm and help them sit upright. Do not let them lie down.

steps.instruction: Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.

instruction_translations.en: Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Help them use their reliever inhaler (usually blue). Give 1 puff every 30–60 seconds, up to 10 puffs.

steps.instruction: If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.

instruction_translations.en: If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they do not have their inhaler, call 112 immediately.

steps.instruction: Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.

instruction_translations.en: Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Stay with them. If they are not better after 15 minutes, call 112.

steps.instruction: If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.

instruction_translations.en: If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.

instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they become unconscious and stop breathing, begin CPR.
